tasks.description: In contents/docs/cdp/sources/stripe.md, clarify in the 'Setting up webhooks for real-time syncing' section that webhook-based real-time ingestion only begins after the first successful sync completes (initial sync), and that a full reset/re-sync temporarily falls back to scheduled syncing until the initial sync completes again. This reflects the new initial_sync_complete gating and reset_pipeline behavior in the webhook S3 ingestion path.

In contents/docs/cdp/sources/index.mdx under the 'Webhook' sync method, note that webhook sync activates only after the table's initial sync has completed and is paused during a full reset, so users understand why real-time updates may not appear immediately after setup.
